newsitem.title: USA: Clinton hails deal between Peru, Ecuador.
newsitem.headline: Clinton hails deal between Peru, Ecuador.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton Tuesday hailed an agreement between Peru and Ecuador to start serious talks for a final settlement to their Amazon border dispute by the end of the year.
"I welcome this milestone in the search for peace," he said in a statement, commending the two countries "for choosing the path of peace and dialogue over conflict and confrontation."

The two neighbours, who went to war briefly in January, announced the plan for talks after a round of negotiations in Chile. They will meet in Brazil to iron out remaining problems that have blocked a final agreement to their Amazon border dispute.
White House spokesman Mike McCurry said the agreement improved the outlook for economic development in both Peru and Ecuador and "strengthens prospects for regional integration and stability."
